cards.name: A Knife in the Dark
cards.quote: Fear lurks in shadows, where the unseen blade strikes true.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy character in your hex: apply Poisoned <sprite name="poisoned"> (2 turns) and Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn).

cards.name: A Mithril Coat
cards.quote: Mithril's light outlasts the pride of kings.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> (3 turns).

cards.name: Ancient Edge
cards.quote: An ancient edge is not soon made dull.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> (1 turn) and Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn).

cards.name: A New Breed of War
cards.quote: Iron will makes soldiers of the raw and fearful.
cards.actionEffect: Choose an allied army in your hex: convert 1 Men-at-arms <sprite name="ma"> into 1 Heavy Infantry <sprite name="hi">.

cards.name: Riders of King Alden
cards.quote: At King Alden's call, riders are awakened from grief.
cards.actionEffect: Allied cavalry <sprite name="ca"> units in radius 2 gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn) and Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Wood Elf Arrows
cards.quote: The Goldenwood host loose their arrows like leaves in storm.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy in same/adjacent hex: deal moderate damage and, if the target is on forest terrain, apply Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Ashen Breath Repaid
cards.quote: What the wyrm burned, the sons of stone answer with iron and wrath.
cards.actionEffect: Remove Burning <sprite name="burning"> from all allied Dwarves in radius 1 and grant them Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Kingsleaf
cards.quote: The kingly leaf comes to hand when the road is darkest.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character: heal 15 HP and remove Poisoned <sprite name="poisoned">/Burning <sprite name="burning">.

cards.name: Attired for the Winelords
cards.quote: Adorned in finery, our spirits lift with the promise of gold.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> (1 turn), and gain 2 gold.

cards.name: Halflings Stay Hidden
cards.quote: A small foot may slip where a dark thought would stumble.
cards.actionEffect: Halflings within a personal radius of 2-4 hexes gain Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> for 1 turn and lose Fear <sprite name="fear">.

cards.name: Barrow Lilies
cards.quote: White blooms at the barrow's edge carry a grief no plough can lift.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in radius 2 gain Despair <sprite name="despair"> (2).

cards.name: Barrow Wight Whisper
cards.quote: The dead whisper from the barrows, and the living grow pale at the sound.
cards.actionEffect: Enemies in radius 2 gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Beacon Hill Watchfires
cards.quote: One flame answers another, and the hills remember that Sunlands still stands.
cards.actionEffect: The beacons are lit. Allied units here gain Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> and lose Fear <sprite name="fear">; enemies here are Halted <sprite name="halted">.

cards.name: Bearer of the Fire Ring
cards.quote: Where Fire Ring burns, the heart does not yield to shadow.
cards.actionEffect: The third ring kindles courage where despair would take root. Heal 1 wounded ally in radius 1, clear Fear <sprite name="fear"> and Despair <sprite name="despair"> from all allies there, and reveal 1 hidden artifact in radius 3.

cards.name: Beasts Bidden to Serve
cards.quote: The birds flew where he commanded, though they knew not whose voice they truly obeyed.
cards.actionEffect: By will alone, the wild things are made to serve. Allied Beasts in radius 3 gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> (2) and Haste <sprite name="haste"> (2).

cards.name: Behind High Elf Shields
cards.quote: Behind High Elf shields, the old pride of the Elves still stands.
cards.actionEffect: All allied elves in radius 1 gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> (1 turn) and lose Fear <sprite name="fear">.

cards.name: Iron Gate Sortie
cards.quote: From the shadows of the gate, we shall strike like a thunderstorm.
cards.actionEffect: All allied army commanders in mountains or hills gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn) and Courage <sprite name="encouraged"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Rumours of Black Sails
cards.quote: Whispers of darkness spread like shadows on the sea.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal the hexes of the nearest 3 enemy units at sea.

cards.name: Blighted Glade
cards.quote: Beneath the rotting boughs, even the earth forgets its old health.
cards.actionEffect: The glade rots and hungers. Enemies on forest tiles in radius 2 are revealed and gain Bleeding <sprite name="bleeding"> (2); allied Spiders there gain Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> (2) and Haste <sprite name="haste">.

cards.name: Old Tarrow's Whim
cards.quote: When the merry fellow laughs, trouble may find itself elsewhere.
cards.actionEffect: None can predict what the Old Man will do next. Reveal Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> enemies in radius 2; the strongest is displaced 5 hexes from any PC or allied unit.

cards.name: Border Patrol
cards.quote: A border well watched is a border half held.
cards.actionEffect: Eyes on the borders, always. Reveal the surrounding area, detect nearby enemies, and Halt an enemy army commander in your hex.

cards.name: Bound in Elven Rope
cards.quote: Elven Rope binds lightly, yet fast as a spoken oath.
cards.actionEffect: Elvish rope remembers who holds it. Target ally gains Hidden <sprite name="hidden">; on forest or mountain tiles they also gain Haste <sprite name="haste">.

cards.name: Bountiful Season
cards.quote: When the year is kind, even the poor have a full board.
cards.actionEffect: Gain +2 <sprite name="gold">, +1 <sprite name="timber">, +1 <sprite name="leather">.

cards.name: Bow of Ilmar
cards.quote: The eastern hunter's bow does not miss what the eye has chosen.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy character in radius 1: wound for 15. If caster has Mage <sprite name="mage"> 3+, also reveal the target's surroundings for 1 turn.

cards.name: Crossway Rumours
cards.quote: Five blind places are named by whisper, and the map remembers them.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal 5 random unrevealed hexes as unseen.

cards.name: Captain of the Outer Wall
cards.quote: To guard the outer wall is to hold the very heart of our realm.
cards.actionEffect: A wall-captain snaps the defense into motion. Choose one allied Human or Firstbloods in radius 2; they may act again this turn.

cards.name: Caravans
cards.quote: Caravans know the price of every road.
cards.actionEffect: Sell up to 3 available resources and gain 25% extra <sprite name="gold"> versus normal sale value.

cards.name: Chains of the Lidless Eye
cards.quote: Bound by the unseen chains, his minions rise to do his bidding.
cards.actionEffect: All Wraithlords gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (3 turns).

cards.name: Chopping the Trees
cards.quote: The axe bites deep; the forest's heart quakes at the sound.
cards.actionEffect: If you are on a forest hex, gain +3 timber; beast- or Ent-race characters here are moderately wounded.

cards.name: Clad in Many Colours
cards.quote: Every school of magic has something to teach, if you can set your pride aside.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal hidden enemies in radius 2. Wound enemies in radius 2 (25 HP). Strip and steal their positive status effects (2 turns).

cards.name: Climbing the White Hills
cards.quote: From high stones, the world opens and the heart remembers hope.
cards.actionEffect: If played on hills or mountains, reveal the surrounding area in radius 2, and allied Halflings and Elf units gain Hope <sprite name="hope"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Cobwebs of Nightwood
cards.quote: The great spiders weave more than silk; they weave dread.
cards.actionEffect: Webs in the dark, patient and wide. Enemies on forest tiles in radius 2 gain Halted <sprite name="halted"> and Poisoned <sprite name="poisoned"> (2); allied Spiders in radius 2 gain Haste <sprite name="haste">.

cards.name: Council in a Shuttered Hall
cards.quote: The windows are barred, the torches low, and every choice sounds heavier in the dark.
cards.actionEffect: In secret rooms, the future is sometimes chosen. Look at the top 3 cards of your deck; put 1 into your hand; if an enemy is within radius 2 of your PC, it gains 5 loyalty.

cards.name: Counsel by Firelight
cards.quote: In the hush before the road resumes, the right counsel may cast aside folly and place a truer course in the hand.
cards.actionEffect: Finds a quieter path: the character becomes Hidden for 2 turns.

cards.name: Counsel in the White Tower
cards.quote: Even in a hall of stone, there is wisdom enough to prune a poor hand.
cards.actionEffect: Discard 1 card and draw 2.

cards.name: Counsel of the Wise
cards.quote: The council sees many paths; only a fool takes the first.
cards.actionEffect: Weighs 3 possible resources and grants 3 of whichever you hold least.

cards.name: Counsel to Elder Rowan
cards.quote: In the House of Elder Rowan, even deep wounds remember how to close.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in this hex is fully healed. Gain Hope <sprite name="hope"> (2 turns).

cards.name: Counsel to Lady Goldleaf
cards.quote: The mirror shows what the willing eye is ready to see.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal radius 3 for 1 turn. Target allied character gains Arcane Insight <sprite name="arcaneinsight"> (2 turns).

cards.name: Unwelcome Counsel
cards.quote: The truth is a bitter draught that weighs heavy on the heart.
cards.actionEffect: Hard truths steady some and undo others. Allied Humans and Firstbloods in radius 2 gain Hope <sprite name="hope">; enemies gain Despair <sprite name="despair">.

cards.name: Deceiving the Tower Council
cards.quote: He told us to seek the Ring in the The Irisfields. He had known for long where it lay.
cards.actionEffect: Lies woven with half-truths, half-believed. Enemies in radius 3 gain Blocked <sprite name="blocked"> (2) and Halted <sprite name="halted">.

cards.name: Destroy the Mill
cards.quote: Where once flour was ground for honest bread, now smoke billows at all hours and the river runs grey.
cards.actionEffect: Reduce loyalty <sprite name="loyalty"> by 10. Enemy PC owner loses up to 3 of each resource.

cards.name: Swanhold Shipyard
cards.quote: Hammers ring beside the tide, and each plank learns the shape of a warship.
cards.actionEffect: If this hex borders the sea, an allied army commander here gains 1 Warship <sprite name="ws"> and its owner gains 1 timber <sprite name="timber">.

cards.name: Blackwood Keep Rises
cards.quote: The hill of sorcery has not slept; it has waited.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in radius 3 gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> (2 turns). Allied characters in your hex gain Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Doors of the Deep Delved
cards.quote: Where others see only stone and dark, the house of Durn remembers how to look deeper.
cards.actionEffect: A hidden door opens into the deep places: the character is delved straight to the nearest Underground hex.

cards.name: Dragon-fire
cards.quote: Feel the heat of the ancient wyrm; it scorches all that dare approach.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in radius 1 gain Burning <sprite name="burning"> (1 turn); enemies on forest tiles also gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Dread of the High Elves
cards.quote: A chill descends, for the light of the Eldar grows dim.
cards.actionEffect: The dread of the High Elves is not remembered without cause. Enemy Elf characters in radius 2 with low Mage are displaced 1 hex westward and lose Hidden <sprite name="hidden">; the caster gains Hidden on forest or coast.

cards.name: Dreams of the Drowned Kingdom
cards.quote: Dreams of the Drowned Kingdom drift westward on the salt wind.
cards.actionEffect: All allied units on shore/water-adjacent tiles gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> and Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Eastern Resolve
cards.quote: In unity we stand, unyielding as the mountains of our homeland.
cards.actionEffect: The two easternmost allied armies gain +1 <sprite name="hc"> and +1 <sprite name="lc">

cards.name: Elven Lull
cards.quote: Soft song and bright lament can still the dark and quicken the hidden road.
cards.actionEffect: A hush falls as starlight settles on the wood. Allied Halflings and Elves in radius 2 gain Haste <sprite name="haste">; Wraithlords gain Blocked <sprite name="blocked">, and Orcs and Trolls gain Halted <sprite name="halted">.

cards.name: Palisades
cards.quote: A palisade hastily raised may still hold a night of dread.
cards.actionEffect: If you are on an allied population center, increase its fortification by 1.

cards.name: Engines from Thornspire
cards.quote: Timber, iron, and fire answer Vaskar's mind; the furnaces labour and the war-machine rolls.
cards.actionEffect: All allied armies in radius 2 gain +25 proc chance to trigger their army ability this turn.

cards.name: The Lonely Mountain Calls
cards.quote: The Mountain remembers its heirs, and the road grows shorter beneath a loyal heart.
cards.actionEffect: All Dwarves and Halflings in this hex gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> for 2 turns.

cards.name: Eye's Tribute
cards.quote: All must bow to the will of the Dark Lord, or face his wrath.
cards.actionEffect: All allies in radius 1 gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> and Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn).

cards.name: False Parley
cards.quote: Words can be as sharp as swords; choose them wisely.
cards.actionEffect: The two easternmost allied armies gain +1 <sprite name="hc"> and +1 <sprite name="lc">.

cards.name: Far-Speaking Thought
cards.quote: Mind may travel where foot cannot, and warning may arrive before the enemy does.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal the hexes of up to 2 nearby enemy units and remove Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> from them.

cards.name: Flame of the Emberpit
cards.quote: In darkness, I ignite fear, for the flames of The Emberpit consume all.
cards.actionEffect: In radius 2, apply Burning <sprite name="burning"> (1 turn) and Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn) to all enemy units.

cards.name: Floating in Barrels
cards.quote: When the river bears them onward, even a poor barrel may hide a quiet road.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Halflings and Dwarf units on the sea in radius 5 move to the nearest land hex and gain Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Silverwater Ford
cards.quote: Silverwater's ford grants passage only on the river's terms.
cards.actionEffect: The ford rises at Elder Rowan’s command and does not forget allegiance. Allied units on shore or water in radius 2 gain Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged">; non-army allies gain Hidden <sprite name="hidden">; enemies there are Halted <sprite name="halted">.

cards.name: Forgefire Kept
cards.quote: So long as the forge remembers its heat, the kingdom is not wholly lost.
cards.actionEffect: One allied Dwarf in this hex gains Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> for 2 turns and 1 iron <sprite name="iron">.

cards.name: Furnaces of Thornspire
cards.quote: The fires of industry roar, crafting weapons for the coming storm.
cards.actionEffect: If you are on a forest hex, gain +3 timber; beast- or Ent-race characters here are moderately wounded.

cards.name: Gargoyles
cards.quote: The stone wardens wake, and the walls themselves take wing.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy character in your hex:  apply Fear <sprite name="fear"> (2 turns) and Halted <sprite name="halted"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Gift of the Evening Star
cards.quote: The Evening Star is a gift given while the West still has breath.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character gains Hope <sprite name="hope"> (2 turns) and removes Fear <sprite name="fear">/Despair <sprite name="despair">.

cards.name: Setting Out
cards.quote: A road once named calls the stout-hearted forth.
cards.actionEffect: Halflings and Dwarves in radius 2 gain Encouraged<sprite name="encouraged">.

cards.name: Sunlands Mustering
cards.quote: He knows every drum-call of the city and every gate that must answer it.
cards.actionEffect: Choose 1 allied army commander in radius 2; it gains 1 Light Infantry <sprite name="li"> and Courage <sprite name="encouraged"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Skeil's Knife
cards.quote: The worm turned at last â€” not from strength, but from despair, and what it did could not be undone.
cards.actionEffect: Roll the dice: <25 caster is assassinated, 25-50 caster is wounded, 50-75 target is wounded, >75 target is killed.

cards.name: Hall of Oaths
cards.quote: Before the carved pillars, grudges are remembered and loyalties made hard as granite.
cards.actionEffect: Your PC in this hex gains +15 loyalty.

cards.name: The Hall Falls Silent
cards.quote: Silence drapes the hall, a prelude to the storm’s arrival.
cards.actionEffect: A hard truth reveals danger around the hall. Reveal all hexes in radius 2, then one allied Human or Firstbloods nearby may immediately reposition 1 step.

cards.name: Hallow the Road
cards.quote: Hallow the road, and the night grows less bold.
cards.actionEffect: Halflings and Dwarves in radius 2 gain Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged">.

cards.name: Harbour Whispers
cards.quote: The docks hum with anticipation, as fate draws near.
cards.actionEffect: Dockside rumor turns to readiness. Reveal the nearest 2 enemy sea or shore threat hexes, and if you are in a PC it gains +2 to +4 loyalty.

cards.name: Healing Herbs
cards.quote: The green herb heals where the blade has left its hurt.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: heal a moderate amount.

cards.name: Heart of the Mountain
cards.quote: The heart of the mountain beats slow, but never dead.
cards.actionEffect: Below stone and silence, the Dwarves do not waver. Allied Dwarf commanders here and adjacent gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> and Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened">; enemies there gain Fear <sprite name="fear">.

cards.name: Heir to the Ranger King
cards.quote: The heir of the Ranger King bears a line that the years could not break.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Humans/Firstbloods in radius 1 gain Hope <sprite name="hope"> (1 turn); caster gains Arcane Insight <sprite name="arcaneinsight"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Hidden in Hides
cards.quote: In rough hides, much that is dear may be concealed.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in your hex are Halted <sprite name="halted"> (1 turn); caster gains Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> (2 turns).

cards.name: Hidden Treasure
cards.quote: Deep under broken stone, the old wealth still waits for hands bold enough to lift it.
cards.actionEffect: Gain 5 gold <sprite name="gold">.

cards.name: Hide
cards.quote: Not all who walk unseen are thieves; some are merely careful.
cards.actionEffect: For 1 turn: invisible to enemy <sprite name="scout"> scout actions, hidden from scouted hexes, and cannot be selected for duels.

cards.name: Hood of Corvan
cards.quote: Beneath Corvan's hood, even the road forgets its traveler.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in this hex gains Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> (2 turns). The caster reveals radius 2 for 1 turn.

cards.name: Hope Reborn
cards.quote: Hope is reborn when all lesser things are spent.
cards.actionEffect: Remove negative status effects in an area of 2 hexes from caster.

cards.name: Host of Thornspire
cards.quote: The Stewards gave him the tower's keys long ago, yet the guest has barred the gate from within.
cards.actionEffect: Can only be played at Thornspire. All allied units in radius 1 become Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Ill News Before Dawn
cards.quote: He comes before daybreak with hard eyes and harder counsel, and sleep ends where his warning falls.
cards.actionEffect: Ill news comes before the sun. Reveal the nearest enemy PC or army in radius 5; if a PC, it loses 10 loyalty; if an army, it is exposed to your scouts.

cards.name: Imprisonment
cards.quote: The Deepholes do not kill — they merely forget. You are there until the Chief decides otherwise.
cards.actionEffect: Kidnap a target enemy character in the caster's hex.

cards.name: Industrialization
cards.quote: Trees fell, water ran foul, and smoke lay low over the hills. The Thornhollow was being improved, they said.
cards.actionEffect: Gain 5 iron <sprite name="iron"> and 5 steel <sprite name="steel">. All PCs in radius 5 lose 15 loyalty <sprite name="loyalty">.

cards.name: Greenmarch Camp
cards.quote: Greenmarch keeps its skill beneath leaf and shadow.
cards.actionEffect: The rangers melt into the shadow of Greenmarch. All allied Firstbloods in radius 5 gain Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Joining the Rangers
cards.quote: To join the Rangers is to take the long road and the long watch.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Firstbloods in radius 2 gain Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> (1 turn), and the caster scouts radius 2.

cards.name: The Black Rider's Command
cards.quote: No ringwraith speaks softly, yet his word moves armies where trumpets fail.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Wraithlords and Orc units in radius 3 gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> (2 turns) and Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Kindle Dawnfire
cards.quote: Kindle dawnfire, and even fear may find a name.
cards.actionEffect: Free Peoples gain Courage <sprite name="encouraged"> as dawn breaks, and Doors of Night is dispelled.

cards.name: King Under the Mountain
cards.quote: A rightful command can wake old halls, old vows, and one last labor before dusk.
cards.actionEffect: Readies 1 allied Dwarf in this hex to act and move again this turn.

cards.name: Merehaven Arsenal
cards.quote: Lake-town stores iron as a poor folk store hope.
cards.actionEffect: Gain +1 <sprite name="iron">, +1 <sprite name="steel">, and +1 <sprite name="timber">.

cards.name: Lanterns at Crossway Gate
cards.quote: Lantern-light leaves little room for shadow.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal all hexes in radius 3 as seen for 1 turn.

cards.name: Last Act of Malice
cards.quote: You have broken my staff, diminished me. So I lay this upon your little land: long shall it take to heal.
cards.actionEffect: Apply Cursed <sprite name="cursed"> (3 turns) to all enemy characters in radius 5 and reduce loyalty by 15 in radius 4.

cards.name: Light the Watchfires
cards.quote: In the flickering flames, the unseen dangers reveal themselves.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal as scouted and seen all hexes in radius 2 of each PC you own for 1 turn.

cards.name: Goldenwood Belt
cards.quote: The belt of Goldenwood is woven for passing in secret.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character: Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> (2 turns) and Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Lyle's Purse
cards.quote: Lyle bought what he could not make and made what he could not buy, and in the end owned neither.
cards.actionEffect: Gain 15 gold <sprite name="gold">. Leather and timber stores go to 0.

cards.name: Slavefort Sorcery
cards.quote: Fear is a weapon sharper than any blade.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy characters in radius 1 gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Lured by Halflings' Leaf
cards.quote: The sweet scent of the Thornhollow can ensnare even the mightiest of foes.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy Celestials in radius 2: Halted <sprite name="halted"> (1 turn) and Blocked <sprite name="blocked"> (2 turns).

cards.name: Lure of the East
cards.quote: Come, wanderers of the West, let the East call you into shadow.
cards.actionEffect: All enemy Celestials aligned free or neutral in radius 2 are teleported to random eastmost non-water hexes and Blocked <sprite name="blocked"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Marked by a Wraithlord
cards.quote: The shadow of the Wraithlords brings a chilling touch of despair.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy character in your hex: apply Wraith Touch (1 turn).

cards.name: Keepsake House
cards.quote: What was put by in peace may yet be found useful in need.
cards.actionEffect: From the old keepsakes, you gain 1<sprite name="iron"> 1<sprite name="steel"> 1<sprite name="mithril">.

cards.name: Nightwood Miasma
cards.quote: The forest exhales a breath older than the sunlit paths.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in radius 2 forest gain Poisoned <sprite name="poisoned"> (3 turns) and are Halted <sprite name="halted"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Passage Through Pale Valley
cards.quote: The dark road cuts where no honest road dares run.
cards.actionEffect: The roads through Pale Valley are not for the living. Teleport a target ally from your hex to any allied Wraithlord’s hex within 5; they arrive Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened">.

cards.name: Mounts
cards.quote: Swift mounts carry hope ahead of danger.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn).

cards.name: New Order
cards.quote: A fresh dawn breaks, heralding the reforge of our ambitions.
cards.actionEffect: Remove all your Gold. Add +5 Timber, +5 Iron, +5 Steel. Gain +2 Fortification at your capital.

cards.name: News for the Horse Plains
cards.quote: Whispers of the world carry heavy tidings on the winds of fate.
cards.actionEffect: Dark tidings travel faster than hope. Allied Humans and Firstbloods in radius 2 gain Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged">; enemy Humans and Firstbloods gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> and Refusing Duels <sprite name="refusingduels">.

cards.name: Northmen Stand Firm
cards.quote: The Northmen stand as weathered timber in the storm.
cards.actionEffect: The men of the North do not break. Target allied Human or Firstbloods wins any forced duel this turn and refuses further duels; the nearest allied PC gains +5 loyalty.

cards.name: The Drowned Kingdom Falls
cards.quote: In the shadowed halls of the Drowned Kingdom, hope crumbled like ancient stone.
cards.actionEffect: Even Núnmenor bowed, in the end. Remove Halted <sprite name="halted"> from a target allied commander; they gain Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged">, and enemies in their hex gain Fear <sprite name="fear">.

cards.name: Oath of the Westerfold
cards.quote: The Westerfold keeps its oath when the reckoning comes.
cards.actionEffect: Humans and Firstbloods in radius 3 gain Courage <sprite name="encouraged"> and Hope <sprite name="hope">.

cards.name: Old Ruins of North Kingdom
cards.quote: Broken kings still leave a brightness in the stones.
cards.actionEffect: North Kingdom, West Downs, and Troll Hills each reveal 2 hexes as seen for 1 turn.

cards.name: The Forest Turns
cards.quote: The old ways know how to turn a path against the walker.
cards.actionEffect: If played in a forest, allied units in this hex gain Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> and Haste <sprite name="haste"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: On the City Fields
cards.quote: Upon the City Fields the horn is answered by valor.
cards.actionEffect: The fields ring with hooves and steel. Target allied army commander here gains Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> (2); cavalry <sprite name="ca"> also gains Haste <sprite name="haste">.

cards.name: Orc Draught
cards.quote: In the depths of despair, even the wicked find a flicker of strength.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: heal a small amount and gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Orc-host of Grimhold
cards.quote: The mountain passes do not empty; they refill.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Orc armies in radius 2 gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn) and Courage <sprite name="encouraged"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Orc Rebellion
cards.quote: The chains of tyranny shall be shattered in the fires of revolt!
cards.actionEffect: Target allied army commander in your hex: gain +1 permanent Commander and lose 1 unit of the weakest army troop type.

cards.name: Orders on the City Fields
cards.quote: A sharp order can move a host faster than a trumpet.
cards.actionEffect: Choose 1 allied Human or Firstbloods in radius 2; it becomes Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> and may move again this turn.

cards.name: Orders in the Night
cards.quote: In shadow, the brave tread where others fear to go.
cards.actionEffect: One trusted soul, one quiet road. Choose 1 allied Human or Firstbloods in radius 2; they gain Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> and may move again this turn.

cards.name: Thornspire's Surveillance
cards.quote: From the tower the wizard sees far, and many who thought themselves unmarked find the gaze already upon them.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal all enemy PCs and armies in radius 4 for 1 turn.

cards.name: Starholt Quartermasters
cards.quote: Ledgers and locks keep a city alive when the river runs red.
cards.actionEffect: The stone city still feeds the war. Choose 1 allied army commander in radius 2; its owner gains 1 <sprite name="timber">, 1 <sprite name="iron">, and 1 <sprite name="gold">, and that army gains 1 XP.

cards.name: Seeing Stone Glimpse
cards.quote: Not all that is seen should be trusted, but even a perilous vision may tear the veil from what was hidden.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal 3 unseen hexes for 1 turn and gain Arcane Insight <sprite name="arcaneinsight"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Seeing Stone of Thornspire
cards.quote: The stone yields knowledge, but never without shadow clinging to the edge of sight.
cards.actionEffect: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Put 1 into your hand and reveal the nearest enemy PC.

cards.name: Kingsquay Ship Captain
cards.quote: He reads wind and harbor alike, and keeps the tide bound to the king's road.
cards.actionEffect: If this hex borders the sea, an allied army commander here gains 1 Warship <sprite name="ws"> and Haste <sprite name="haste"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Kingsquay War Galleys
cards.quote: The tide takes the ships out hard and brings them back stronger.
cards.actionEffect: A commander in an owned port gains 1 Warship <sprite name="ws">.

cards.name: Pipe-weed Monopoly
cards.quote: All the pipe-weed of the Thornhollow flows through Lyle's hand, and Lyle's hand belongs to the Chief.
cards.actionEffect: Gain 5 gold <sprite name="gold">. Draw Lured by Halflings' Leaf and The Lure of the Senses if hand size allows.

cards.name: Pitch from the Murder-Holes
cards.quote: What the deep keeps in cask and cauldron, it may pour on the heads of invaders.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in this hex gain Burning <sprite name="burning"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Protect the Fords
cards.quote: The river shall not run red with the blood of the innocent.
cards.actionEffect: Hold the crossings; let none pass. Allied units on shore or water-adjacent hexes gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified">; enemy units there are Halted <sprite name="halted">.

cards.name: Provided by the Elves
cards.quote: The Elves give with grace, not haste.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: heal a moderate amount.

cards.name: Raid from the Mountains
cards.quote: The mountains whisper of swift vengeance; the raiders heed the call.
cards.actionEffect: All allied army commanders in mountains or hills gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn) and Courage <sprite name="encouraged"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Raise the Inner Bastion
cards.quote: Stone laid upon stone is memory made useful against the dark.
cards.actionEffect: Increase the fort level of your PC in this hex by 1.

cards.name: Rallied Men
cards.quote: When the call goes out, old loyalties wake.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Human units gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> (1 turn).

cards.name: The Outer Wall
cards.quote: The outer wall stands as a line drawn in dust and faith.
cards.actionEffect: All allied units here gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> and enemy units here are Halted <sprite name="halted">.

cards.name: Reach of Weftspire
cards.quote: Darkness looms where the Eye's gaze can reach, chilling the hearts of the brave.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in radius 1 gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn) and Halted <sprite name="halted"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Ready the Gates
cards.quote: Steel and stone shall hold against the coming storm.
cards.actionEffect: Ready the gates: an owned PC at this hex gains +1 fortification.

cards.name: Reclaiming the Lonely Mountain
cards.quote: To reclaim Lonely Mountain is to call the Dwarves home again.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Dwarves in radius 2 gain Hope <sprite name="hope"> (1 turn) and Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Refuse Duel
cards.quote: The coward lives; the proud man feeds the crows.
cards.actionEffect: Decline a pending duel challenge.

cards.name: Mossgable Rabbits
cards.quote: In the moonlight, mischief hops back home.
cards.actionEffect: If the caster is not in an army, return the caster to capital.

cards.name: Riders Sent in Haste
cards.quote: There is no time for a full muster; only enough for the right man to be already on the road.
cards.actionEffect: Move the current character to the farthest owned PC, and that PC gains 5 loyalty.

cards.name: Sight Through the Council Ring
cards.quote: He wore a ring on his finger.
cards.actionEffect: The stone sings to those who know how to listen. The caster gains Haste <sprite name="haste"> (2) and reveals all Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> enemies within 4 hexes.

cards.name: The Council Calls
cards.quote: The ring upon the Pale Hand weighs heavier than iron, and those who see it know the tower's will.
cards.actionEffect: The stone calls to the Tower Council. Allied characters here heal 15 (25 on Thornspire); allied army commanders gain 1 Heavy Infantry <sprite name="hi"> (2 on Thornspire).

cards.name: Rings of Lore
cards.quote: The council remembers what the world has forgotten.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal as seen the hexes where Lady Goldleaf, Elder Rowan, and Orren Greycloak stand.

cards.name: River Lilies
cards.quote: Where the river runs clear, even shadow loosens its grip.
cards.actionEffect: All Halfling characters in radius 2 shake off weariness: restore their action and movement, removing Blocked if present.

cards.name: Road to Hollowvale
cards.quote: There are roads that remember the brave.
cards.actionEffect: The road west is ever kind to the small and the stubborn. Halflings and Dwarves in radius 2 gain Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> and Haste <sprite name="haste">; Fear <sprite name="fear"> and Halted <sprite name="halted"> are cleared.

cards.name: Robe of Many Colours
cards.quote: The colours shift as each new spell is woven into the cloth.
cards.actionEffect: The colours dazzle and the moment passes. Strip all positive effects from a target enemy and their hex-mates; the caster gains Haste <sprite name="haste"> and Hidden <sprite name="hidden">.

cards.name: Robes of Brannoc
cards.quote: The brown robes carry the memory of root and feather.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in this hex heals 20 health. If caster is on forest or grasslands, also heal caster for 10.

cards.name: Room at the Last Inn
cards.quote: A warm room mends what the road has frayed.
cards.actionEffect: Heal all characters in your current hex by 15.

cards.name: Scents of the Southlands
cards.quote: A whisper of poison carried on the winds of war strikes true.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy character in your hex: deal moderate damage and apply Poisoned <sprite name="poisoned"> (2 turns).

cards.name: Liberating Thornhollow
cards.quote: There is no corner of this land they will not reach, no garden they will not uproot, no window they will not darken.
cards.actionEffect: Destroy the fortifications of an enemy PC in radius 3 and reduce its loyalty by 20.

cards.name: Scout Area
cards.quote: The wise general counts the enemy's fires before lighting his own.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal surrounding hexes and detect hidden enemy characters nearby.

cards.name: Seal the Lower Gates
cards.quote: Stone answers stone, and the deep way is denied to the foe.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in this hex gain Halted <sprite name="halted"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Secrets from a Lost Tome
cards.quote: Some lore sleeps long before it is fit to be read.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> artifacts in radius 2 and gain +1 <sprite name="mage"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Set Out at Once
cards.quote: He that lingers loses the advantage of the road.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn) and Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Shade of the Barrow-king
cards.quote: The grave-gold of West Downs still calls to the hand that knew it first.
cards.actionEffect: The Cairn-wight remembers old oaths and older grudges. Steal 1 transferable artifact from a random enemy in radius 1; that enemy gains Fear <sprite name="fear"> and Despair <sprite name="despair">.

cards.name: Shielded
cards.quote: A shield is but a promise made in wood and steel.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> (1 turn), and if the target has Fear <sprite name="fear"> remove it.

cards.name: Village Watch and Hedge Wardens
cards.quote: A quiet watch keeps the lanes from forgetting themselves.
cards.actionEffect: All hexes of the Thornhollow are seen for 1 turn.

cards.name: Shroud of Cinderplain
cards.quote: Darkness enfolds the land, swallowing light and hope alike.
cards.actionEffect: Grants Courage <sprite name="encouraged"> to all Dark Servants units for 1 turn and dispels Dawn.

cards.name: Signal Fires of the Beacon Hills
cards.quote: One flame answers another, and the hills remember that Sunlands still stands.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal 10 random mountain hexes as seen for 1 turn.

cards.name: Tales of the First Age
cards.quote: The first age left few answers, but its stories still teach us what to ask.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: gain Arcane Insight <sprite name="arcaneinsight"> (1 turn), and your next FindArtifact here is easier.

cards.name: Sniped!
cards.quote: A swift arrow flies, carrying the promise of fear and pain.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy in same/adjacent hex: inflict small wound and Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Stand of Swanhold
cards.quote: Swanhold stands as the sea meets iron.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character: gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Stay the Dark Tale
cards.quote: Not every shadow must be faced at once; sometimes wisdom is to close the book and choose another hour.
cards.actionEffect: Not every shadow must be faced at once: dismiss one already-discovered encounter at a hex you have found.

cards.name: Steward's Muster
cards.quote: At the Steward's muster, the people remember old duty.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Human units gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened">.

cards.name: Storm from Thornspire
cards.quote: Vaskar's word falls like iron from the tower, and the weary find themselves driven to one more deed.
cards.actionEffect: All friendly units in this hex can action again.

cards.name: Storm Warning from Kingsquay
cards.quote: A tempest brews upon the waters; heed the warning.
cards.actionEffect: If this hex borders the sea, the current commander gains 1 Warship <sprite name="ws">.

cards.name: Struck by a Wraith Blade
cards.quote: A wound that festers, a touch of the dark arts.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy character in your hex: apply Wraith Touch (3 turns).

cards.name: Study of the Rings
cards.quote: He had spent long years in the study of ring-lore, and his knowledge of their making was second to none among the living.
cards.actionEffect: Knowledge of the Nine strips away what others would hide. The caster gains Haste <sprite name="haste"> (2) and reveals all Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> enemies within 4 hexes.

cards.name: Swift as the Wood Elves
cards.quote: The Goldenwood host go swift and soundless among the leaves.
cards.actionEffect: None move through forest as the Goldenwood host do. Target ally gains Haste <sprite name="haste"> and Hidden <sprite name="hidden">; on forest tiles they also lose Fear <sprite name="fear">.

cards.name: The Five Ride Again
cards.quote: When the five kindle their fire, no shadow dares stand before them.
cards.actionEffect: The order convenes where power gathers. All allied Celestials teleport to Thornspire or the nearest allied capital; those already at Thornspire gain +1 permanent Mage <sprite name="mage">.

cards.name: The Battle of Millpond
cards.quote: At the Battle of Millpond they fell upon the ruffians from hedge and ditch — and the Thornhollow was its own again.
cards.actionEffect: Destroy all enemy light infantry <sprite name="li"> forces in radius 3.

cards.name: The Skinchanger Toll
cards.quote: At the Skinchanger toll, all travelers pay in coin or courtesy.
cards.actionEffect: Fortify the caster for 1 turn and halt enemy units in the same or adjacent hexes.

cards.name: The Blade Reforged
cards.quote: A blade once broken may yet be made whole.
cards.actionEffect: Reforged from shards, it carries hope as well as edge. Target allied character gains +1 <sprite name="commander">, loses Fear <sprite name="fear">, and gains Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> (2).

cards.name: The Blow of Cinderplain
cards.quote: A strike steeped in malice, leaving fear in its wake.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy character in your hex: deal moderate damage and apply Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn).

cards.name: The Eye Watches
cards.quote: The Black Tower sees a frightened crowd and calls it peace.
cards.actionEffect: Allied units in radius 1 gain Courage <sprite name="encouraged"> (1 turn); enemy units in radius 1 gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn).

cards.name: The Ford
cards.quote: A ford may be a road to one and a snare to another.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in radius 2 that stand beside water are Halted <sprite name="halted"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: The Greenway
cards.quote: Along the old road, quick feet and faithful hearts may yet outpace the shadow.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Halflings, Firstbloods, and Dwarf units in radius 2 gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> for 2 turns.

cards.name: The Hidden Script
cards.quote: What was forgotten is not always lost; sometimes it merely waits for the right reader.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal 1 hidden artifact site.

cards.name: The Horn Calls
cards.quote: When the horn calls, fear is put to shame.
cards.actionEffect: When the horn sounds, the scattered answer. Reveal Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> enemies in radius 3; allied Humans and Firstbloods in radius 2 gain Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> and close 1 hex; enemies here are Halted <sprite name="halted">.

cards.name: The Hollow Sorcerer's Whisper
cards.quote: A voice not quite heard finds the cracks in every shield.
cards.actionEffect: Whispers from the tower find every crack in the mind. Reveal Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> enemies in radius 2 and inflict Despair <sprite name="despair"> (2); visible enemies in radius 1 gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> if none were hidden.

cards.name: The Power of the Water Ring
cards.quote: Water Ring keeps a hidden gleam against fading days.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied PC: hide it for 2 turns and grant Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> to nearby allied units.

cards.name: The Power of the Air Ring
cards.quote: Air Ring's light endures where wounds would not close.
cards.actionEffect: Allied characters in radius 1 are fully healed, and Foam on the Water is cast in radius 2-4 depending on the caster's Mage <sprite name="mage"> level.

cards.name: The Wayfarer's Inn
cards.quote: A welcoming inn can gather the far-wandered home.
cards.actionEffect: Move up to 2 Halflings, Firstbloods, or Dwarf allies from adjacent hexes into your hex, and heal them 10.

cards.name: The Sack of the Hill House
cards.quote: When the halls stood empty, hungry hands came softly in the dusk.
cards.actionEffect: Steal one transferable artifact from a random enemy character in your hex, if any are present.

cards.name: The Second Sending
cards.quote: He too was given a road that led away, veiled in counsel that sounded like care.
cards.actionEffect: Move the caster to a random hex on the map. Gain Arcane Insight <sprite name="arcaneinsight"> (3 turns).

cards.name: The Tower's Kindness
cards.quote: He spoke softly, as one who tends a friend, yet the door was locked from without.
cards.actionEffect: All mages at Thornspire gain Arcane Insight <sprite name="arcaneinsight"> (3 turns), but are Halted <sprite name="halted"> (1 turn).

cards.name: The Wraith King's Decree
cards.quote: No edict from Grimhold arrives without a shadow at its back.
cards.actionEffect: None dispute the Wraith King’s decree. Allied Wraithlords in radius 2 gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> (2); enemies in radius 1 gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> (2).

cards.name: The King Awakens
cards.quote: When King Alden awakes, the courage of Horse Plains wakes with him.
cards.actionEffect: The king returns to himself, and the shadow falls away. Target allied character permanently gains +1 <sprite name="commander">, loses Fear <sprite name="fear">, and gains Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> (2).

cards.name: The Stone Sinks
cards.quote: The waters whisper secrets of lost kings and shattered dreams.
cards.actionEffect: If any Free People character holds a Seeing-stone, remove it from the character and hide it in a random water hex.

cards.name: The Northern Rangers
cards.quote: The Northern Rangers rode from the North in silence, bearing the hope of the Firstbloods.
cards.actionEffect: Choose allied Firstbloods in radius 3 and distribute +1 <sprite name="commander">, +1 <sprite name="agent">, and +1 <sprite name="emmissary"> among them.

cards.name: The Iron Crown Rides Again
cards.quote: Rise, my dark steed, and let the night reclaim the sky.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied Wraithlords in your hex gains +1 Commander and +1 Mage.

cards.name: Lure of the Senses
cards.quote: In the haze of battle, the senses deceive, and danger lurks unseen.
cards.actionEffect: Block target enemy character for 1 turn. If it is a Celestial, block it for 3 turns.

cards.name: The Nine Ride Again
cards.quote: Once more, the dark riders gallop forth, terror in their wake.
cards.actionEffect: All Wraithlords gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (3 turns).

cards.name: Through Nightwood Shadows
cards.quote: The dark boughs press close, but stout hearts still find the hidden deer-path.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal 5 unseen forest hexes for 1 turn.

cards.name: Token of the Woodland Realm
cards.quote: A token from the Woodland Realm bears more than memory.
cards.actionEffect: A gift from the Lady’s hand is never given lightly. Target ally gains Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> (3) and +1 to skill checks while Hidden; Elves also reveal Hidden enemies in an adjacent hex.

cards.name: Train Army
cards.quote: Discipline is the iron that outlasts the blade.
cards.actionEffect: Train your <sprite name="army">army, granting it experience.

cards.name: Transfer Artifact
cards.quote: Power passes most safely through hands that do not grasp.
cards.actionEffect: Pass a carried <sprite name="artifact">artifact to another character in the same hex.

cards.name: Traps
cards.quote: A snare laid unseen waits longest of all.
cards.actionEffect: Target enemy character in your hex: apply Blocked <sprite name="blocked"> (1 turn) and Poisoned <sprite name="poisoned"> (2 turns).

cards.name: Travel in Safety
cards.quote: A road safest of all is the one that brings folk home at last.
cards.actionEffect: Move all characters in this hex to your capital.

cards.name: Travel through the Marsh
cards.quote: The mire keeps counsel with no one.
cards.actionEffect: The bogs swallow armies and hide the small. Enemies on swamp or shallow water in radius 2 gain Poisoned <sprite name="poisoned"> and Halted <sprite name="halted">; allied Halflings there gain Hidden <sprite name="hidden">.

cards.name: Treasures of the Woodland Realm
cards.quote: In the Woodland Realm, treasure is kept where root and bough defend it.
cards.actionEffect: All allied Elf characters in radius 2 gain Hope <sprite name="hope"> (1 turn), and one wounded allied character in your hex heals a moderate amount.

cards.name: A Feast Under the Trees
cards.quote: There was laughter in the green, and the dark could not abide it.
cards.actionEffect: Halflings, humans, and dwarves in radius 5 gain Encouraged<sprite name="encouraged"> for 1 turn, and troll units are Halted <sprite name="halted">.

cards.name: Tribute to Nharok
cards.quote: From the shadows, a tithe is gathered for the Dark Lord's power.
cards.actionEffect: Enemy units in radius 1 gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> (1 turn) and Halted <sprite name="halted"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Troll's Hoard
cards.quote: Not all plunder belongs to the fools who piled it in the dark.
cards.actionEffect: Gain 1 random hidden artifact you do not already own.

cards.name: Uncautious Supper
cards.quote: A flame unwatched at meal may summon the long eye of night.
cards.actionEffect: At supper or rest, Halflings in radius 2 lose Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> and take 15 damage.

cards.name: Under the First King's Banner
cards.quote: the First King's banner is still a pledge to the Faithful.
cards.actionEffect: Allied Humans and Firstbloods in radius 2 gain Hope <sprite name="hope"> and Encouraged <sprite name="encouraged"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Under Mountain Banners
cards.quote: When the old standards are raised again, even the deep halls seem to march.
cards.actionEffect: All allied Dwarf army commanders in radius 1 gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Under the Pale Hand
cards.quote: A shadow looms, and the banners of Vaskar stir with dark promise.
cards.actionEffect: All allied units in radius 2 gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Unexpected Fireworks
cards.quote: Bright sparks may unmask the wary and send the timid running.
cards.actionEffect: All Halflings in radius 2 gain Hope <sprite name="hope"> for 1 turn, and all hexes in radius 3 are seen for 1 turn.

cards.name: War Orc Vanguard
cards.quote: March forth, War Orcs! Let the banners fly in fierce honor!
cards.actionEffect: All allied armies in radius 2 gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Fate's Loom
cards.quote: She weaves all things that have ever been in Time into her storied webs.
cards.actionEffect: Unweave the thread of your last card: its cost is fully refunded, and the character may act again this turn.

cards.name: Vein of True Silver
cards.quote: What the mountain withholds from the idle, it yields to the stubborn and the wise.
cards.actionEffect: Gain 3 mithril <sprite name="mithril"> and replace 1 card in your hand with the The Deepflame encounter card.

cards.name: Visions in the Mirror
cards.quote: What the mirror reveals is not soon forgotten.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal unseen hexes equal to Mage <sprite name="mage">, up to 7.

cards.name: Visions of the Western Isle
cards.quote: Visions of the Western Isle are a westward dream the Wise do not cast aside.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied Elf in your hex gains Arcane Insight <sprite name="arcaneinsight"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Voice of Authority
cards.quote: A word spoken with rightful power bends the will without breaking it.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied population center: gain +15 loyalty and +1 <sprite name="gold">.

cards.name: Wall of Oak and Iron
cards.quote: Shield kissed shield, and the narrow way became a wall no foe could lightly break.
cards.actionEffect: All allied Dwarves in this hex gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: War Spoils
cards.quote: Spoils won by war are often bitter to count.
cards.actionEffect: The spoils of war fill hands and harden hearts. Gain 2 <sprite name="iron">, 1 <sprite name="steel">, and 1 <sprite name="leather">; choose 1 allied character here to gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> or Fortified <sprite name="fortified">.

cards.name: Ward Against the Eye
cards.quote: A ward set against the Eye is a shield for the unmarked way.
cards.actionEffect: Choose 1 allied character in this hex; they gain Arcane Insight <sprite name="arcaneinsight"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Wardens of the Outer Wall
cards.quote: The wall remembers every oath that was spoken for it.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal as unseen all hexes in radius 2 for 1 turn.

cards.name: Watch at Crook Hollow
cards.quote: With the doors barred and the lane watched, the village can sleep for another night.
cards.actionEffect: Allied units in the hex reset their movement spent to 0 and gain Refusing Duelds <sprite name="refusingduels"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Windtop
cards.quote: On the watch hill, the stone itself seems to command stillness.
cards.actionEffect: The old watchtower commands all approaches — and traps those who hold it. All units here gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> and Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> but are Halted <sprite name="halted"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Well-equipped Army
cards.quote: Well equipped hosts are less shaken by the first terror.
cards.actionEffect: All allied armies in radius 2 gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Orders from the Black Tower
cards.quote: From the depths of shadow, commands echo with cruel urgency.
cards.actionEffect: All allies in radius 1 gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> and Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn).

cards.name: The Ashen Muster
cards.quote: From the depths of ash and shadow, we rise to reclaim our dominion.
cards.actionEffect: All allies in radius 1 gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> and Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Driven by the Whip
cards.quote: The crack of the whip heralds a surge of relentless might.
cards.actionEffect: All allied armies in radius 2 gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (3 turns).

cards.name: White Script of the Citadel
cards.quote: Old marks in old hands still know where to find the hidden road.
cards.actionEffect: Reveal an artifact site.

cards.name: White Tower Arsenal
cards.quote: Every spear in the storehouse is a promise against the dark.
cards.actionEffect: All allied army commanders here gain Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> and Shielded <sprite name="shielded">.

cards.name: White Tower Bastion
cards.quote: The white stone does not yield while the watch is kept.
cards.actionEffect: An owned PC at this hex gains +1 fortification.

cards.name: Wisdom of the Ages
cards.quote: Old lore heals where steel cannot reach.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character in your hex: heal 20 HP. If the target has Mage <sprite name="mage"> skill, also gain +1 <sprite name="gold">.

cards.name: Words of Warding
cards.quote: A single phrase, rightly spoken, may set a stronger wall than stone.
cards.actionEffect: One allied character in this hex gains Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> and Arcane Insight <sprite name="arcaneinsight"> for 1 turn.

cards.name: Skeil's Whisper
cards.quote: In the ears of kings, whispers weave deceit like silken threads.
cards.actionEffect: All allied units in radius 2 gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> (1 turn).

cards.name: Woven by Wood Elves
cards.quote: The Goldenwood host weave cloaks that hide even longing.
cards.actionEffect: Target allied character: gain Haste <sprite name="haste"> (1 turn) and Hidden <sprite name="hidden"> (2 turns).

cards.name: Wyrm's Shadow
cards.quote: The winged terror needs not strike; its passing alone unravels defiance.
cards.actionEffect: Something vast and fire-breathing turns its eye southward. Enemy commanders in radius 2 lose Fortified <sprite name="fortified"> and gain Fear <sprite name="fear"> (2); allied Dragons gain Strengthened <sprite name="strengthened"> (2).
